description: This file contains a PHP class 'Returns' within the namespace Opencart.Admin.Controller.Sale, responsible for handling administrative sale return functionalities including listing, filtering, and processing return data.

classes.name: Returns
classes.description: Controller class for managing sale return processes in the admin panel, including listing, filtering, and actions related to returns.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the main view rendering for the sale returns page, including processing filters from GET requests and setting up breadcrumbs and data for the view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a JSON response with the list of returns based on the current filters and pagination.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates the filtered list of return records as a JSON string, based on request filters such as return ID, order ID, customer, product, model, return status, date range, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Renders the form view for creating or editing a return, processing filters, and setting up data such as return reasons and return actions.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving or updating return data, including validation, permission checks, and invoking model methods for insert or update operations.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected return records based on provided IDs, with permission validation.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Displays the history of a specific return, including listing past actions and statuses.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Returns a string of HTML containing the history records for a specific return, including pagination and details of each history entry.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds a new history record for a specific return, updating status, comments, and optionally notifying the customer, with permission validation.
